game.name: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2
game.rules:
***General Rules***

*FOV:* 50-120.

*FPS:* 60-250. Capped through "com_maxfps 250" command or other means.

*Manual tampering with game files* is prohibited (e.g. mixing files with different languages) 

          Installing an in-game velocity meter is the only exception

*Skins:* Glove & shirt skins are okay, but no other cosmetics allowed (i.e. weapon, map, enemies, teammates).

Devsave and loadgame commands are banned during runs.

*"Load Glitching"* is prohibited, no matter accidental or not. Load Glitching is sound files being unable to open due to game malfunctioning and therefore skipping dialogue.

Timer offset for Any% is *-12.06*

***Submission Requirements***

- Video that shows from the start to end of the category, where it is easy to tell what's going on.
- Video FPS of at least *30.*
- In-game audio is clearly audible.
- Ammo information visible bottom left and right at all times - default setting, don't have to do anything.

***Additional Requirements If Your Time Is Within Top 10***

- *cg_drawFPS "Simple"* enabled and clearly visible.
- [*Livesplit Velocity Meter(click to download)*](https://www.dropbox.com/s/opo67uk2ntprtff/LiveSplit.MemoryGraph.dll?dl=0), or  [*In-game Velocity Meter (click to download)*](https://drive.google.com/file/d/15De2CScyJrPVX1FIBAxs8UK09mNEXV29/view), must be shown on video, functional [where applicable].

***World Record submissions for co-op runs must include recordings for both players***

categories.name: Any%
categories.rules:
**Timing Starts:** When *S.S.D.D.* load ends/S.S.D.D. Restart Level Equivalent.

**Timing Ends:** When you lose control after the knife throw at *Endgame.*

**DO NOT** manually pause the timer during loads. 

If you want to time your run without loads included then you should be using a load remover. [(click to download)](http://www.mediafire.com/file/565a4w15mqx9e92/mw2_AutoSplitter.asl/file)

If you do not use a load remover, your run will be submitted with load times included.

*This does not apply to running on console however.*
